author: BIGMIND300
quote:
The best game ever made.
I cried, I smiled, I laughed, I got angry—and felt every other emotion a human can feel. Except **** to think I almost didn’t give this game a chance because of the turn-based combat.
The combat and soundtrack are top-tier. You can count on one hand the number of studios that can rival Sandfall on these fronts.
But the story… Oh, the story. There’s no other game on the same level. They raised the bar so high, I don’t think another game will reach it for a very, very long time.
Story: 100/10
Soundtrack: 20/10
Gameplay: 20/10
Dear Lord, I am so grateful this game was made.
Thank you, Sandfall Interactive. Please, make more games.
